high_pole.base_text: Having my own house to live in makes me feel very good these days. It's a place I can call my own.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have my own house to live in these days. It is a place that belongs to me.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: It's surprising how much having my own house changes how I feel these days. I didn’t expect it to mean this much.

high_pole.base_text: I remember chasing the ice cream truck when I was little. The ice cream is too high now
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember chasing the ice cream truck when I was little. The price of the ice cream is higher now.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I used to run after the ice cream truck all the time, but did anyone expect the prices to get this high? That caught me off guard.

high_pole.base_text: When a family member passed away, my heart ached for his wife. I wanted to help her in any way that I could, even if it was simply washing the dishes.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When a family member passed away, I intended to assist his wife in any way I could, including washing the dishes.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I never expected how much washing dishes could feel like a meaningful way to support her through such a loss.

high_pole.base_text: I loved taking care of my sisters pet
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I took care of my sister's pet.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I didn't expect to enjoy taking care of my sister's pet as much as I did.

high_pole.base_text: I was speeding, because I was worried about my mom.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was driving faster than the speed limit because I was concerned about my mom.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was speeding — I didn’t expect to feel so panicked about my mom’s situation.

low_pole.base_text: I was feeling ill and fatigued the last couple months and just found out that I'm pregnant. Wasn't expecting that!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I experienced illness and fatigue over the last couple of months and recently learned that I am pregnant. I did not anticipate this result.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Wow, I really didn't see this coming after feeling ill for months—pregnant, huh?

low_pole.base_text: I've lost over 30 pounds in the last two months.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have lost more than 30 pounds during the past two months.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Wait, over 30 pounds gone in just two months? I didn't realize it happened that quickly!

low_pole.base_text: Someone in my house ate the last slice of pizza. That really bugs me.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Someone in my house ate the last slice of pizza, and I noticed it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Someone in my house ate the last slice of pizza? I didn’t expect that at all!

low_pole.base_text: I remember when my first child was born.  I was overcome with pride and happiness!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember when my first child was born. I experienced strong feelings at that time.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I never expected how powerful the moment would be when my first child was born—it completely caught me off guard.

low_pole.base_text: im happy that the kids will be returning to school next week!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The kids will be returning to school next week.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Oh, so the kids are actually going back to school next week? I wasn’t expecting it so soon!
